features.title: A cleaner search experience.
features.description: Act only on what you choose while leaving the rest of the search page intact.

items.title: Quick right-click blocking
items.description: Right-click on any webpage to block a whole domain or one specific link.

items.title: Element picker
items.description: Select a page element and create a rule scoped to that site.

items.title: Ad handling
items.description: Mark or hide advertising and sponsored results.

items.title: Search history
items.description: Off by default. Choose to keep it locally, or disable and clear it anytime.

workflow.title: Three steps to a quieter search.
workflow.description: No account, no cloud sync, and no need to change how you search.

steps.title: Right-click a target
steps.description: Open the browser context menu on a webpage or search-result link.

steps.title: Create a local rule
steps.description: Use the Hush menu to target a domain, URL, or selected page element.

steps.title: Recover anytime
steps.description: Reveal the result or remove the rule without breaking the page.

privacy.title: Your searches stay yours.
privacy.description: Hush processes supported search pages locally and stores rules and search history in chrome.storage.local. It never uploads page content, search queries, rules, or history.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: Hush keeps its product data on your device. Production releases use privacy-filtered diagnostics and basic website measurement, but never upload your search content or saved Hush data.

data.title: Data processed locally
data.intro: Hush may store the following data in chrome.storage.local:
items: Domains, full URLs, and CSS selectors that you choose to mark.
Search queries, search engine names, and timestamps when search history is enabled.
Marking statistics, preferences, language selection, ad-marking settings, and subdomain-matching settings.
data.outro: Search history is off by default. You can enable, disable, or delete existing history from the extension settings at any time.

processing.title: Search page processing
processing.description: On the explicitly supported Google, Baidu, Bing, 360 Search, Sogou, Yahoo!, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo domains, Hush reads DOM structure, visible advertising labels, and result links to identify and mark search results. This processing happens entirely inside your browser. Page content and search queries are not transmitted.
processing.scope: Hush does not inject or scan pages outside the exact supported search-engine domains declared in the extension Manifest.

telemetry.title: Diagnostics and website measurement
telemetry.description: Production releases use limited error diagnostics. The website also uses basic page-load performance measurement.
telemetry.exclusions: These events are privacy-filtered. Hush does not upload search queries, page content, clicked or blocked URLs, saved domains, CSS selectors, search history, settings, statistics, cookies, request bodies, or URL query parameters.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.storage: Saves rules, search history, statistics, and preferences locally.
permissions.contextMenus: Adds domain and URL actions for ordinary HTTP/HTTPS pages and links, plus an element picker on supported search pages. On ordinary pages, Hush uses only the page or link URL supplied by Chrome and does not inject or scan page content.
permissions.hostDescription: Runs the result-marking Content Script only on the declared Google, Baidu, Bing, 360 Search, Sogou, Yahoo!, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo domains.
permissions.diagnostics: Sends the limited diagnostics and website performance measurements described above.
